newsitem.title: USA: Ford plans sporty Lincoln sedan for 1999- WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Ford plans sporty Lincoln sedan for 1999- WSJ.

text.p: Ford Motor Co. plans to unveil a new "sporty" luxury sedan in 1999 for its Lincoln unit, the Wall Street Journal said on Monday.
The newspaper said in its electronic edition that Ford announced its intention Sunday at a dealer conference in San Diego Sunday.
The new model will be offered with either a V-6 or V-8 engine, and will be smaller than the present Lincoln Mark VIII, Continental and Town Car models, the newspaper said.
In launching the new sporty sdean, Ford is hoping to attract younger buyers to its Lincoln division.
Lincoln now does not offer any sporty sedans, and is losing sales to domestic rivals, such as Cadillac, according to the paper.
